searchText: I noticed FULU is not present but BPOs are (https://light-mainnet.beaconcha.in/) cc <@808969530608451584> is it expected? 🙂 Well, not right, but explainable: https://light-mainnet.beaconcha.in/clients/consensus?o=index dora took the spect from node2, which isn't updated yet 😄 dora doesn't have logic to use the "most used" spec values.
